pages.title: Starlight Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted at a crafting table with 4 Glowstone, 4 Amethyst Shards and 1 Diamond.$(br2)§lCondition: §r Works while in a Curios slot, or in the main hand / off hand.$(br2)Night Stroll: +20% movement speed at night.$(br)Star Eyes: automatically gain Night Vision at night.$(br)Starlight Echo: experience from mob kills is doubled.$(br2)Night is only recognised in dimensions with a day-night cycle (ticks 13000~23000); it never triggers in the Nether or the End.
The grid above shows the layout: glowstone in the corners, amethyst shards on the edges, diamond in the center.
